en.overview: Stepped rice paddies carved into steep hillsides, supporting diverse aquatic and wetland species through traditional water management.
what_to_look_for: Frogs and tadpoles in shallow water
Dragonflies and damselflies patrolling the paddies
Wetland plants and wildflowers along the earthen levees
Stone or earthen retaining walls with moss and ferns
confirm_more: Wide landscape shot showing the stepped tiers and surrounding slope
Close-up of the water surface, aquatic life, or rice plants
Detail of the retaining wall structure and levee vegetation
management_signs: Mowed or cleared grass along the earthen levees
Intact water inlet/outlet pipes and irrigation channels
Signs of abandonment such as overgrown shrubs or collapsed walls
en.seasonal_note: Flooded in spring for planting, lush green in summer, golden before autumn harvest, and often drained in winter.

ja.overview: 急斜面を切り開いて作られた階段状の水田です。伝統的な水管理によって、多様な水生生物や湿地性の生き物を育んでいます。
what_to_look_for: 浅瀬にいるカエルやオタマジャクシ
水田の上を飛び回るトンボやイトトンボ
あぜ道に咲く湿地植物や野草
コケやシダに覆われた石積みや土留めの壁
confirm_more: 階段状の景観と周囲の斜面がわかる広角写真
水面、水生生物、または稲のクローズアップ
石積みやあぜ道の植生の詳細
management_signs: あぜ道の草刈りや整備の跡
維持管理された取排水口や水路
放棄された場所に見られる低木の繁茂や石積みの崩落
ja.seasonal_note: 春は田植えのための湛水、夏は青々とした緑、秋の収穫前は黄金色に輝き、冬は水が抜かれることが多いです。
